title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts, RAG templates, and docs site updates
author: Liam Chen
body:
This PR adds a set of developer-facing quickstarts and example templates for building RAG-based agents that invoke external tools via Redwood's tool-calling interface, and updates the docs site navigation and content to surface the new quickstarts. Motivation: provide repeatable examples teams can copy into their repos to accelerate integration of RAG + agents with tool calling (search, DB lookup, external API). What changed: 1) docs/guides/rag-templates.md: new comprehensive guide describing template patterns (chunking strategies, prompt formatting, retrieval fallbacks). 2) examples/rag-agent/tool-calling/quickstart.ts and quickstart.py: minimal end-to-end examples demonstrating embedding store wiring, retriever config, and tool registration. 3) examples/rag-agent/playbook.md: opinionated runbook for production patterns and observability knobs. 4) site/content/docs/agents/tool-calling.md: docs site page explaining the tool-calling primitives and linking to quickstarts. 5) site/config/nav.yml: added nav entries and cross-links. 6) docs/releases/notes-2026-02.md: release notes snippet. Compatibility and migration: no breaking API changes; examples target existing SDKs and the hosted API. Testing and validation: ran docs-lint and site build locally; smoke-tested TypeScript and Python quickstarts against local devstack and a small hosted token; added unit examples to examples/README. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates guide - [x] Add TypeScript quickstart - [x] Add Python quickstart - [x] Update docs nav and cross-links - [x] Add release notes snippet - [x] Run docs-lint and site build - [x] Get approvals from Docs and SDK owners
Notes: The initial docs-lint run flagged a link and a markdown style rule which I fixed in the follow-up commit. No runtime changes to the serving runtime are included in this PR, it's purely docs and examples. Links: related Linear ENG-4872 for example standardization and DOC-219 for docs nav update.
commits: 3 commits: 1) Add base RAG templates guide and examples scaffold, 2) Implement TS/Python quickstarts and playbook, 3) Fix docs-lint errors and update nav entries
